ITEM 1 | Wilted dark green leafy greens, glossy and slightly limp with a light sheen suggesting dressing, forming a loose mound about 10 cm across and covering roughly 35% of the square white plate, leaves folded and overlapping, slightly pooled at the edges | 90
ITEM 2 | Thin julienned orange strips, bright orange with slightly darker edges, scattered in short matchsticks about 3-5 cm long and 0.3 cm wide, dispersed over and around the greens, raw and firm-looking | 12
ITEM 3 | Two small whole red cherry-shaped fruits, glossy smooth bright red skin, each about 2 cm in diameter, one slightly larger, resting on the left side of the greens next to the leaves | 14
